description: Finds Park Graph parking lots near a latitude and longitude, nearest first, with spaces left and the current rate. No API key needed. Each lot's id is the lot_id that get_lot, the quote tool and reserve take. The top-level summary is a one-line, plain-language answer. An empty lots list means Park Graph has no lots near that point. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

radius_km.description: Search radius around that point, in km

name: search_lots
